_: Les sons des créatures au combat (tools/audio/sons.py). L'id est le nom du son dans le jeu (data/sounds.json) : <créature>-<action>, l'action « impact » (le coup qui porte), « death », « shoot », « shot-impact ». Descriptions en anglais (« no music » est ajouté à la demande).

sons.texte: monk casting a fireball from his hands: a short chant syllable and a whoosh of fire launching
small fireball hitting a soldier: a fiery burst and crackle
an old rusty sword chops into a wooden shield: a dull metallic chop, with a quick hollow clatter of loose skeleton bones
skeleton collapsing into a pile of dry bones, clattering on the ground
a huge fat belly slams into a body: a deep dull muffled thud of soft heavy flesh, wet and meaty, low and organic, no voice
fat zombie dying: a wet gurgling moan, a squelch and a heavy body flopping down
a female ghost strikes: a cold ghostly shriek that cuts sharply, with an icy whoosh, eerie, short and loud
ghost dissolving: a fading ethereal wail drifting away into echoes
giant spider bite: fast clicking legs, a hiss and a venomous fang bite
giant spider dying: a shrill hiss, legs twitching and curling up, a dry crunch

vampire dying: an agonized hiss turning into dust, a rush of bat wings flying away
